obfuscation_indicators: forward-looking statements subject to risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally transparent and quantitatively supported, reporting revenue growth, cash flows, debt payments, dividends, and contractual obligations. Risk tone is moderately positive, but COVID-19 impacts, freight and logistics costs, regional concentration, semiconductor cyclicality, and uncertain tax liabilities remain material risks. Standard forward-looking disclaimers and omitted table content limit assessment of some exposures.
